== Summary ==
A bowling champion glass at the venue while Team Wales set up for the 2022 Naboo Regionals in Bromborough, near Liverpool. The organizers held a Friday-night bowling tournament with prizes.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-07-22
